# WG14 · Tài chính · kỳ đã chi

Group **WG · Tài chính PB02** · state · Next.js: **planned (U6)** (`/finance`) · account `owner-tam`

## Logic source
- Old web: `prototype/finance/finance.js#work`
- Old web: `prototype/finance/finance.js#table`
- Finance PB02 is `prototype/finance/finance.js` (`PemaFinance.html()` + `mount(root)`), mounted inside the clinic shell; data comes from the Python API `finance_server.py` on 127.0.0.1:4174 with the headers `X-Pema-Role` and `X-Pema-Doctor`.
- `finance.js › work()` for a paid period: badge "Đã chi", no period button (the "Chốt" and "Xác nhận đã chi" buttons are gone), rows without actions. Period 2026-07.
- Same guarded set-up as WG13 (entry P003, linked to WEB:P003:HD-0003), then "Xác nhận đã chi" with the voucher code asked by a native prompt (the reach answers "Demo").
- Inventory note: Period 2026-07: badge "Đã chi", no period button. Same guarded set-up as WG13 (entry P003 linked to WEB:P003:HD-0003), then "Xác nhận đã chi" with a voucher code.
- Page key `finance` is allowed for roles: owner, doctor, accountant (`staff-context.js` › pages). Shown here with account `owner-tam`.
- Capabilities (`staff-context.js` › capabilities): clinical: owner/doctor; crm: owner/care/doctor; booking: owner/care/doctor; billing: owner/accountant; config: owner; readFinance: owner/accountant/doctor.
- No control on this screen is removed by a capability check.
- How to reach it in the old web: {"goto":"/clinic-web/?staff={role}"} → {"click":".sidebar [data-nav=\"finance\"]"} → {"wait":".finance-workspace .metric, .finance-workspace .hero"} → {"click":"[data-finance-tab=\"work\"]"} → {"setValue":["#month","2026-07"]} → {"wait":"#export"} → {"ifVisible":["td:has-text(\"Chưa có lượt thủ thuật\")",[{"click":"#content details > summary"},{"wait":"#entry"},{"select":["#entry [name=patient]","P003"]},{"setValue":["#entry [name=date]","2026-07-10"]},{"select":["#entry [name=invoice]","WEB:P003:HD-0003"]},{"fill":["#entry [name=note]","Đã thực hiện, chờ đối soát"]},{"click":"#entry [type=submit]"},{"wait":"[data-command=\"approve\"]"}]]} → {"ifVisible":["[data-command=\"approve\"]",[{"click":"[data-command=\"approve\"]"},{"wait":"[data-command=\"close\"]"}]]} → {"ifVisible":["[data-command=\"close\"]",[{"dialog":"accept"},{"click":"[data-command=\"close\"]"},{"wait":"[data-command=\"paid\"]"}]]} → {"ifVisible":["[data-command=\"paid\"]",[{"dialog":"accept"},{"click":"[data-command=\"paid\"]"},{"wait":".finance-workspace .badge:has-text(\"Đã chi\")"}]]}; it must show "Đã chi".

## Layout (top to bottom, region → src/ui component)
Every field, action, status, filter and text of the old screen is listed; rows and cards that repeat show the first one with demo values and their count. `old="…"` is the old CSS class, `// key=value` the old `data-*` hook that carries the behaviour.
```tsx
<AppShell role="owner-tam">  // sidebar and top bar are the same on every page (WA1-WA3); active menu item "Tài chính & tiền thủ thuật", page key "finance"
  <Row gap="20px" justify="space-between">
    <Text small>"ĐIỀU HÀNH • PEMA CLINIC"</Text>
    <Heading level={1}>"Tài chính & tiền thủ thuật"</Heading>
    <Row old="tools" gap="12px" wrap>
      <Field label="Kỳ báo cáo" type="month" default="2026-07" id="month" />
      <Button variant="secondary">"Làm mới"</Button>
    </Row>
  </Row>
  <nav aria-label="Phân hệ tài chính" old="finance-tabs">
    <Tabs items={["Tổng quan","Tiền thủ thuật","Chính sách tỷ lệ","Phiếu thu & thông báo"]} selected="Tiền thủ thuật" />  // financeTab
  </nav>
  <Card old="panel">
    <Row old="row" gap="12px" justify="space-between" wrap>
      <Heading level={2}>"Bảng tiền thủ thuật • 2026-07"</Heading>
      <Badge tone="neutral" old="badge">"Đã chi"</Badge>
      <Button variant="secondary">"Xuất CSV cho Excel"</Button>
    </Row>
    <TableShell columns={["Ngày / Hồ sơ","Thủ thuật / Bác sĩ","Doanh số phân bổ","Cơ sở × tỷ lệ","Tiền thủ thuật","Trạng thái"]} rows={1}>
      <Row sample="first of 1; demo values, the other rows have the same cells">
        <Cell column="Ngày / Hồ sơ">
          <Text>"2026-07-10" <Small>"P003"</Small></Text>
        </Cell>
        <Cell column="Thủ thuật / Bác sĩ">
          <Text>"Tái khám & đánh giá" <Small>"BS. Tâm"</Small></Text>
        </Cell>
        <Cell column="Doanh số phân bổ">
          <Text>"300.000 ₫"</Text>
        </Cell>
        <Cell column="Cơ sở × tỷ lệ">
          <Text>"300.000 ₫ × 10%" <Small>"Giá sau giảm"</Small></Text>
        </Cell>
        <Cell column="Tiền thủ thuật">
          <Text strong>"30.000 ₫"</Text>
        </Cell>
        <Cell column="Trạng thái">
          <Badge tone="neutral" old="badge">"Đã duyệt"</Badge>
        </Cell>
      </Row>
      <RowVariants>statuses "Đã duyệt" (badge) ×1</RowVariants>
    </TableShell>
  </Card>
</AppShell>
```
Kit components used: Button×2, Badge×2, Field×1, Tabs×1, Card×1, TableShell×1. Everything else (Row, Grid, Stack, Text, Heading, Progress, Avatar, Facts, Repeat, Cell…) is a plain element styled with tokens; W3 turns the recurring ones into web blocks.

## Business rules
- Revenue ("Doanh số thực hiện") follows the completion date of the procedure; cash ("Thực thu") follows the receipt date; they are tracked separately.
- "Tiền thủ thuật đã duyệt": "Không phải lợi nhuận phòng khám".
- Native dialogs used on the way here: confirm "Chốt số liệu tháng 2026-07? Các lượt trong kỳ sẽ bị khóa." and prompt "Mã chứng từ chi" (see WG17, WG18).
- "Tiền thủ thuật đã duyệt": "Không phải lợi nhuận phòng khám".

## Differences from the app design
- App H4 has no paid-period state, badge "Đã chi" or voucher code.

## Gotchas
- The tab content refreshes every 10 s (`setInterval`) unless an input has focus or the entry form is open; a pending form is never overwritten (`dirty` flag).
- Without the API the page shows "Chưa kết nối dữ liệu tài chính: <error>. Chạy python prototype/finance_server.py rồi thử lại." in `#error` (see WG9).
- The voucher code (`reference`) is sent to the server but not shown on this tab.
- Writes to the shared finance database (row of 2026-07, closed and paid), like WG13.
